desc: Implement fast stdin parsing and store the original sequence A compactly while building a frequency array of values up to max(A).
Add fast paths for K = 1 (answer is A_i) and K = N (answer is gcd of all A_i).
Compute, for each d from 1 to max(A), the number of array elements divisible by d using a multiples loop over the frequency array.
For each d with count >= K, update a best-divisor array for all multiples of d so that each value stores its largest valid divisor.
Generate the N answers by mapping each original A_i through the best-divisor array, using buffered/chunked output to avoid excessive memory use.
Check edge cases such as duplicate values, all values equal, max(A) = 1, and verify the implementation stays within time/memory limits.
Verify the solution against the provided sample tests.
